core_A.idea: between two switches: two switches flip the same target; it must leave between the two firings

core_B.idea: the pattern's rhythm: a pattern spinner (cw, cw, ccw) must ram two shells in turn

core_C.idea: unlock, open, pull: the gate's link is locked; the magnet must wait for both

core_D.idea: reverse to ram, ram to open: the shell the reversed rammer cracks is the gate's link

core_E.idea: gate chain: one gate's link waits behind the other gate

core_F.idea: bring the shell: a magnet pulls the shell into the only rammer's lane - the rammer must not leave first

core_G.idea: the key aims the lock: the departing key turns the locked spinner onto the shell

core_H.idea: a key that leaves in two steps: the Sequence key's advance turns the locked spinner without unlocking it; its escape unlocks and turns it again

core_I.idea: flip and spin: a pattern spinner is also a switch target - turns and a reversal combine
core_I.rejected: engine rule: a spinner cannot be a switch / flip target (LevelManager)

core_J.idea: lock ladder: each lock's key is itself locked
core_J.rejected: unsolvable as drawn (PuzzleDefinition.verify = the Solver must clear it): no order frees the lock chain

core_I2.idea: two shells, two rammers: spend each rammer on the right shell, and keep both until their shell is cracked

core_J2.idea: one departure, two effects: the switch is also the last key of a lock - its timing serves both
